a.speaker: Arlo Dunmore
a.text:
"You've done that before," Arlo says, which you haven't.

[How it works] Every action costs Action Points (AP). Quick shots are cheap; aimed shots cost more and hit more often. Cover between you and a target cuts the odds. Tap a foe to see the exact chance before you commit. A hit 40 points under the odds is a solid hit for half again the damage.

Firearms +3. Real fights also have Call Out (make them back down) and Parley (let them leave).
